::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

### R

```{r}
#| label: convex-hessian-fig-r
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Contour plot of f(x) = exp(2 x1 + x2) - x1 for x1 from -1 to 1 and x2
#|   from -3 to 3. The level curves are long parallel curves that run along
#|   the direction (1, -2), crowded together on the upper right and spread
#|   out on the lower left. A dashed vermilion line along that direction
#|   through the origin marks where f is linear.
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 5
ch_x1_ch <- seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101)
ch_x2_ch <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 101)
ch_grid_ch <- tidyr::expand_grid(x1 = ch_x1_ch, x2 = ch_x2_ch)
ch_u_ch <- 2 * ch_grid_ch$x1 + ch_grid_ch$x2
ch_grid_ch$z <- exp(ch_u_ch) - ch_grid_ch$x1
ch_line_x1_ch <- c(-1, 1)
ch_line_x2_ch <- c(2, -2)
ch_line_ch <- tibble::tibble(x1 = ch_line_x1_ch, x2 = ch_line_x2_ch)
ch_aes_ch <- ggplot2::aes(x1, x2)
ch_z_aes_ch <- ggplot2::aes(z = z)
ggplot2::ggplot(ch_grid_ch, ch_aes_ch) +
  ggplot2::geom_contour(ch_z_aes_ch, colour = "#0072B2", bins = 12) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    data = ch_line_ch, colour = "#D55E00", linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "x1", y = "x2")
```

### Python

```{python}
#| label: convex-hessian-fig-python
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Contour plot of f(x) = exp(2 x1 + x2) - x1 for x1 from -1 to 1 and x2
#|   from -3 to 3. The level curves are long parallel curves that run along
#|   the direction (1, -2), crowded together on the upper right and spread
#|   out on the lower left. A dashed vermilion line along that direction
#|   through the origin marks where f is linear.
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-width: 5
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

ch_x1_ax = np.linspace(-1, 1, 101)
ch_x2_ax = np.linspace(-3, 3, 101)
ch_xx_ax, ch_yy_ax = np.meshgrid(ch_x1_ax, ch_x2_ax)
ch_z_ax = np.exp(2 * ch_xx_ax + ch_yy_ax) - ch_xx_ax
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 4), layout="constrained")
ax.contour(ch_xx_ax, ch_yy_ax, ch_z_ax, levels=12, colors="#0072B2")
ax.plot([-1, 1], [2, -2], "--", color="#D55E00")
ax.set_xlabel("x1")
ax.set_ylabel("x2")
plt.show();
```

:::

[Level curves](vector-calculus.qmd#def-level-set) of the third [function](functions.qmd#def-function) in @exm-convex-hessian.
Along the dashed line through the origin in the [direction](vector-calculus.qmd#def-direction) $\tp{(1, -2)}$ the function is [linear](algebra.qmd#def-linear-function),
so the function is [convex](algebra.qmd#def-convex-function) but not [strictly convex](#def-strictly-convex).

:::
